h: Aircraft, reservoirs and a north London bounce
p: Colindale has an aviation story running through it. The area grew up around the old Hendon Aerodrome, one of the early centres of British flying, and the RAF Museum now stands on part of that historic site. It's a fitting place for an attraction where everybody gets a bit of air time. Before your session, make sure everyone's had a drink and a light snack, and take a moment to agree who's looking after whom inside, especially if you've got several little ones racing off in different directions.

Once you've finished on the inflatables, the RAF Museum is free to visit and has hangars full of planes from the earliest days of flight right through to modern jets. It's an easy way to make a whole day of it without moving the car. Brent Cross shopping centre is a short hop away for food and shops if you need a refuel.

Nature lovers might like the Welsh Harp, the local name for Brent Reservoir, where you can spot water birds and enjoy a walk along the edges. A bit further down the Northern line, Hampstead Heath has rolling grassland, ponds and the famous view from Parliament Hill across the London skyline. For a quieter green space closer to home, Sunny Hill Park in Hendon has open fields and play areas. Colindale tube station is on the Edgware branch of the Northern line, so getting here from central London is straightforward. Weekend roads around the A41 and M1 can be busy, so allow a bit of extra time if you're driving.
